title: Path Escaping Error - userProfiles Tool
problem: userProfiles command fails with path parsing error: 'C:\Users' path not properly escaped in PowerShell
evidence: Error: Path parsing fails (backslash escaping issue)
Single quotes do not protect backslash in PowerShell string expansion
Affects all tools using Windows path literals
cause: Backslash in path needs escaping in PowerShell command strings. Single quotes in shell pass through double-quoted strings which interpolate backslashes

recommended_actions.action: Use PowerShell escape syntax: double backslash or backtick-escape in paths
Create path helper function to normalize path escaping
Standardize all path arguments in modules to use escaped syntax

notes: Related to IC-003B: Variable escaping but specific to path strings with backslashes
